role: The note-block note: colour from the note pitch, grows over 6 ticks.
scope_reason: In scope: playing a note block by hand (BlockNote.onBlockActivated or onBlockClicked, no redstone needed) queues a block event whose client half spawns 'note' (BlockNote.java:109).

members.name: EntityNoteFX
members.note: EntityFX(x,y,z,0,0,0), motion x0.01 and +0.2 up, the colour from the note (vx = note/24) through MathHelper.sin, scale 0.75 x 2, six ticks, texture 64

members.name: renderParticle
members.note: the scale over (age + pt) / maxAge x 32, clamped to 1

members.name: onUpdate
members.note: PLIVE_NOTE: move, x1.1 when stopped, x0.66, x0.7 on the ground

notes: No behavior is ported. The scene renderer csrc/engine/raster_particles.c draws whatever class names the recorded state dump lists (base quads or icon quads), so a dump containing this class would render, but nothing constructs or ticks it natively. idxaudit 2026-09-27: was client_cosmetic/not_applicable; the scope reason did not hold (DEVLOG 2026-09-27, lane/idxaudit). Spawned by BlockNote.onBlockEventReceived on the client (survival.c's S24 handler, through the particle setting's gate: at the pinned minimal setting nothing is built and nothing drawn). lane/idxlast 2026-09-27: proven by the rendertick scene fx_client (seed 1, --particles 0, 143 ticks, 3,923 FX compared field by field against the oracle's dump, test_rendertick); it fails with the class changed (a negative control of 80 mismatches).
